title: Dark fireball (testman 236C)
brief: testman's fireball: a slow, menacing mid-screen projectile (6 px a frame) with a 13-frame startup. It must read instantly as dangerous at match zoom, against bright and dark stages, and look like the same character as the rest of the kit. The in-game look is Void Vortex; round 1 asks whether another direction is stronger, round 2 pushes Void Vortex itself.

style.motifs: A black void at the core with violet veins swirling inside; a pale lilac rim with crackling lightning; an uneven heartbeat that throws shockwaves; the stage bending round it; sparks pulled in and swallowed. Impacts flash white, then negative, then burst into black shards.

rounds.name: Round 1: directions
rounds.note: Six really different takes on the flight, all sharing the in-game charge and impact and the character's palette. Pick the ones worth pushing, reject the rest, and fork any you tweak.

variants.name: Void Vortex (in game)
variants.pitch: What ships now: the void with one spiral aura arm, a short wisp trail and the stage bending round it.

variants.name: Eclipse
variants.pitch: A black sun: a flame corona round the void, two tilted orbit rings whose comets pass in front of and behind it, and speed streaks behind.

variants.name: Shadow Serpents
variants.pitch: Ribbons coil round the line of flight, crossing in front of and behind the core, tapering into a long wake. Reads as something alive.

variants.name: Rift
variants.pitch: Not a ball but a tear in the world: inside the slit the stage shows in negative, its lips crackle with lightning, black flakes peel off the back.

variants.name: Grasping Shadow
variants.pitch: The void reaches for the opponent: shadow fingers stretch forward and clench as it flies, pale at the tips, with a smoky wake.

variants.name: Obsidian Comet
variants.pitch: A faceted black crystal with hard cel highlights, a ring of orbiting shards and a trail of sharp triangles flickering out. Clean and graphic.

variants.name: Sumi Ink
variants.pitch: A wet ink blot dragging a calligraphy stroke: dry-brush gaps towards the tail, bleeding edges, splatter. The orb's veins still swirl in the blot.

rounds.name: Round 2: Void Vortex pushed
rounds.note: Same shaders as the in-game look, different values: how drilling down on a pick looks. Tell me which way to push, or fork your own.

variants.name: Vortex: three arms, quicker
variants.pitch: Three spiral arms turning twice as fast and a longer wisp trail: busier, more motion read at a glance.

variants.name: Vortex: heavy
variants.pitch: Bigger, slower and heavier: a wide aura, a strong uneven heartbeat and the stage bending hard round it.

variants.name: Vortex: clean read
variants.pitch: Fewer sparks, a short trail, a gentler bend and a white rim: the quietest, clearest silhouette.

variants.name: Vortex: violet glow
variants.pitch: The one change the palette rules out: a saturated violet glow round the void. Turn on Lock palette to compare it on-model.
